build_pnacl_ir_from_c: build a pnacl-ir pipeline that compiles C files to LLVM bitcode using pnacl-clang and pnacl-opt
run_pnacl_clang_compile: run pnacl-clang with -O2 optimization to compile a C source file into LLVM IR
run_pnacl_opt_abi_simplify: run pnacl-opt with ABI simplification passes on LLVM IR output
run_pnacl_opt_verify: run pnacl-opt with verify-pnaclabi-module and verify-pnaclabi-functions checks enabled
run_pnacl_opt_debug_metadata: run pnacl-opt with -pnaclabi-allow-debug-metadata to preserve debug information
